maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring cloud phone (UCaaS/CCaaS) subscriptions and software licences, not repair or replacement of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private businesses buying VIP cloud phone service; schools and nonprofits are only a minor segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly comes from selling its VIP platform and licensing it to partners; acquisitions like NetSapiens were occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Business phone and contact-centre system; switching means migration, retraining and downtime risk, and it advertises a 100% uptime guarantee.
